description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and extension methods for configuring named services within the Orleans hosting framework. It includes a configurator class, an interface, and extension methods for setting up options and components for named services.

classes.name: NamedServiceConfigurator
classes.description: A class implementing INamedServiceConfigurator that holds the name and configuration delegate for a named service.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Extension method to configure options for a named service.

methods.name: ConfigureComponent
methods.description: Extension method to add a singleton component and configure options for a named service.

methods.name: ConfigureComponent
methods.description: Extension method to add a singleton component to a named service.

methods.name: ConfigureLifecycle
methods.description: Extension method to configure lifecycle for a service implementing ILifecycleSubject.
